title: Epic branch carries 8 worker RESULT-*.md reports to main's root
description:
RESULT-{378,3gk,7uv,hn6,ltg,oro,r5i,v16}.md sit at the repository root on the integration branch; the epic's PR would land them on main, which #172 cleaned of exactly this ('a worker's report is a run's transport, not a file of the project'). report_merge.go says existing reports 'stay until somebody removes them'. And #169's guard does not cover the base-fold-through-resolve path: ab0cdab4 (2026-10-04, after #169 was on the branch) rewrote RESULT-hn6.md. Remove the eight files from epic/hn6 and route the base-fold resolve merge through keepReportsOut.
evidence: git ls-tree HEAD --name-only | grep RESULT; git diff ab0cdab4^1 ab0cdab4 --stat -- RESULT-hn6.md; internal/reconcile/report_merge.go:1-30

ticfac run epic-hn6 filed this backlog tick from the finding 0f60cb7e645be8550868116f17d1ff70a97e09726e80d29f2f899f685ec3acd0 (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-v16/attempt-1): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/0f60cb7e645be8550868116f17d1ff70a97e09726e80d29f2f899f685ec3acd0.json on the run branch.
notes: 2026-10-04 18:17 - ticfac run epic-hn6: created by absorbing finding 0f60cb7e645be8550868116f17d1ff70a97e09726e80d29f2f899f685ec3acd0 — a backlog tick: the done is reachable with the finding standing. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/0f60cb7e645be8550868116f17d1ff70a97e09726e80d29f2f899f685ec3acd0.json on epic/hn6, and it says: the classifier put 0.07 of its probability mass on the items rather than on none, below the deliberately cheap absorb threshold of 0.35: the done is predicted reachable with the finding standing, and a real defect the done does not need is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb
